system.text:
Whether true or not, this character has been branded a coward. In Dwarven society, this stain comes not from breaking an oath, but from refusing to swear the oath in the first place. Branded a Coward grants the character a 1D infamous reputation with either Dwarven Nobles, Clansmen, Guilders, Artificers or the Host. Player’s choice. And more important, this Dwarf may not swear an Oath until he has redeemed himself in the eyes of his longbeard.

Type: Dt (die trait). Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Dwarven lifepath trait

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 316
